title: A Twin-Court Canon of Bloodletting
summary: A canon of paired wounds that teaches how to burst fine vessels in matched pairs until the body of the target drains of its own accord.

title: The Dual-Track Heart Manual
summary: A manual that teaches the cultivator to run two hearts on two tracks at once and to pour both into one overwhelming blow.

title: The Hawk's Quarry Canon
summary: A canon of the hawk's art of finding a pulse across a distance and following it down to a single decisive stoop.

title: A Basin-and-River Treatise on Mending Blood
summary: A treatise on healing as a river fed from a basin of vital blood that washes a wound clean and calls a stopped heart back.

title: The Azure Mirror Manual of Blood
summary: A manual of mirrored guard in which the blood turns blows back on the striker and can drink the force of an attack whole.

title: The Wind-Sworn Pulse Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the wind-sworn that sets the pulse to the run of the gale and ends in a rush no guard can read.

title: The Book of Blood Oaths
summary: A book of oaths sealed in blood that teaches how a vow is bound into a body and how its breach is made to cost the breaker.

title: The Bearing of the Steady Heart
summary: A manual of the steady heart that holds its bearing against any push and needs no wall to stand firm.

title: A Treatise on the Wind-Fed Mend
summary: A treatise on healing carried on the wind that cools fever and cleans taint and breathes life back into the fallen.

title: The Gale Surge Canon of Unwalled Flesh
summary: A canon of the open body that fights without a guard of stone and drives a surge of blood and wind into every blow.
